extraction.name: NWPU-RESISC45
extraction.description: A large-scale benchmark dataset for remote sensing image scene classification containing 31,500 images, covering 45 scene classes with 700 images in each class.
extraction.creator: Gong Cheng, Junwei Han, and Xiaoqiang Lu (Northwestern Polytechnical University)
extraction.rai:dataCollection: The dataset was extracted by experts in the field of remote sensing image interpretation from Google Earth (Google Inc.). The images cover more than 100 countries and regions all over the world, including developing, transition, and highly developed economies.
extraction.rai:dataCollectionType: Secondary Data analysis, Manual Human Curator
extraction.rai:dataCollectionRawData: Google Earth (Google Inc.) imagery, which maps the Earth by the superimposition of images obtained from satellite imagery, aerial photography and geographic information system (GIS) onto a 3D globe.
extraction.rai:dataPreprocessingProtocol: Images were carefully selected under all kinds of weathers, seasons, illumination conditions, imaging conditions, and scales. They were formatted to a size of 256x256 pixels in the red green blue (RGB) color space.
extraction.rai:dataAnnotationProtocol: Images were manually extracted and categorized into 45 meaningful scene classes by experts in the field of remote sensing image interpretation.
extraction.rai:annotatorDemographics: Experts in the field of remote sensing image interpretation
extraction.rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset enables the development of algorithms for intelligent earth observation, which has applications in natural hazards detection, land use and land cover determination, geospatial object detection, vegetation mapping, environment monitoring, and urban planning.
extraction.rai:dataUseCases: Training, testing, and evaluating various data-driven algorithms, especially deep learning-based methods, for remote sensing image scene classification.
